# Market and Growth

Implementation state: specified-only

## Fundamental question

Who needs SSLS, how do we responsibly communicate value, and what may we legitimately claim?

## Purpose

Hold responsible external communication and every claim SSLS may legitimately make.

## Boundaries

- Current: No live pipeline, no customer relationship system, no outbound communication.
- Future: Opens when SSLS has a released capability, approved claims, and a commercial authority.

## Objects it must never display

- Live customer relationship data
- Real contact records of any person
- Any claim without a linked evidence record

## Metrics

### Refused claims on the record

- Question answered: Which statements has SSLS explicitly declined to make?
- Source: Claims register
- Calculation: Count of claims with a refused posture.
- Freshness: As current as the claims register.
- Interpretation: A record of restraint that protects future credibility.
- Must never be read as: Not a backlog of claims waiting to be approved.
- Action triggered: Review whether new evidence changes any refusal. Usually it does not.
